rationale: Pinned DeepSeek defineTool provides schema inference plus execute-time validation; raw registration still owns input validation, while registry enforces canonical output. Cordis cleanup is lifecycle scoping, not sandboxing. ContextTools descriptors/schemas/native argument admission and CodingCommands operation descriptors/fixed checks are two concrete local definition consumers to inspect for duplication. Measure semantic compatibility before any decorator/base class; do not split large modules mechanically or replace ToolRunner.
duplicate_disposition: Existing qualified proposal owns the pressure; preserve its payload, parent and state. Source/test research only: no new B-number, approval, grant, inference or implementation.
